g.text: exec(code) # noqa: S102 — the vulnerability under test
Crafted input makes the model emit Python that executes on your server
Do not execute model output. If you must, run it in a locked-down sandbox and validate
against a strict allowlist of operations — never a denylist and never a human-confirmation gate
alone; both have been bypassed in real CVEs.
Langflow, CISA KEV, exploited in the wild

e.g. SELECT-only via a SQL parser
use parameterized queries for any user-supplied values.

Never pass model output to a shell. Use
